race.comment: FIRE 'N' STONE (5) appreciated the class drop and rails draw with a tough on speed second over 1200m at Bathurst. Hard fit now and another win looks imminent. MRS BULL (8) tough mare who doesn't know how to run a bad race. Back in trip from the wide draw with a courageous on speed second over 1300m at this track. Gets every chance in this winnable contest. TRIFECTA RUBY (11) holding her form in weaker company and looks well placed with Stiff's claim. Will be running on late and deserves another chance. SUTTON STORM (7) impressed on resumption to get the Maiden win out of the way over 1100m at Narromine. Similar set-up again and not to be underestimated.
